title: TreeAI D1 scenario result
description: One result file per implementation and scenario. Producers: Agent B (sdk-node, runs layout under evidence/sdk/runs/<run-id>/<scenario>/result.json) and Agent C (rpc-python, flat layout under evidence/rpc/<scenario>.result.json). The status vocabulary is exactly PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN. A PASS claim must be traceable to raw events and a zero exit code; a FAIL claim must carry a non-zero exit code and a structured error. Cross-file traceability (evidence files exist, events validate, seq increases, no cross-run mixing) is enforced by scripts/verify-d1. Revision 2026-09-18 (Agent D): for status=BLOCKED, blockedReason may be encoded either at the top level (enum below) or inside the error object (error.blockedReason); the task book section 14 names the marker literally 'BLOCKED_CREDENTIALS' and the delivered sdk-node evidence encodes it as error.blockedReason='BLOCKED_CREDENTIALS', so both encodings are accepted and at least one is required. This is a documented schema revision, not a silent change; see schemas/README.md section 4.

implementation.description: Which probe produced this result. Must match the evidence directory (sdk or rpc).

scenario.description: Which of the five unified D1 scenarios. Must match the file name.

status.description: Exactly one of the four unified states. Markdown-only claims of success are not acceptable.

blockedReason.description: Required when status=BLOCKED (either here at the top level or as error.blockedReason). CREDENTIALS is the schema-native encoding of the task book's BLOCKED_CREDENTIALS; BLOCKED_CREDENTIALS is the task-book-literal form and is accepted in both locations.

startedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. The empty string is only allowed while the scenario has not run.

endedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. The empty string is only allowed while the scenario has not run.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the scenario run in milliseconds.

command.description: Exact shell command a third party can re-run to reproduce this scenario. Paths relative to the d1-spikes/ root. Must not contain secrets.

exitCode.description: Process exit code of the command above. 0 for PASS, non-zero for FAIL.

evidenceFiles.description: Paths (relative to the d1-spikes/ root) of raw evidence backing this result, for example evidence/sdk/basic.events.jsonl. Non-empty for PASS and FAIL.

observations.description: Facts observed during the run; each must be traceable to the evidence files.

limitations.description: Known limitations of this run (for example model or timeout constraints).

blockedReason.description: Alternative location for the BLOCKED reason (task-book-literal encoding, as delivered by sdk-node). Satisfies the BLOCKED requirement together with, or instead of, the top-level blockedReason.

error.description: Structured error for FAIL (or the blocking cause for BLOCKED).
